meta_title: TreniDay — free home workouts that feel like a game
meta_desc: TreniDay is a free home workout app with Goro the gorilla: bodyweight skill branches from wall push-ups to a handstand, yoga and stretching courses, streaks, ranks and achievements. No ads, no account.
app_desc: Short bodyweight workouts at home with Goro the gorilla: skill branches, courses, streaks, ranks and achievements. Free, no ads, no account.
tagline: Home workouts that feel like a game
lead: Short bodyweight workouts with Goro the gorilla. Grow your skills step by step — from knee push-ups to a handstand — and keep the streak burning.
hero_note: The web version works on any phone today. Add it to your home screen.
goro_line: Today is a good day to get a little stronger.
plank_desc: Forearm push-up position. Body forms a straight line from heels to head.
step1_p: Calisthenics, Healthy Body, Yoga, Morning Routine or Evening Stretch — or put your own course together from any exercises.
step2_p: Goro shows every move. Holds start by themselves and a sound tells you what comes next, so you never have to look at the screen.
step3_p: More reps, then more sets, then shorter rests — then a challenge, and the branch moves on to the next stage.
ex_sub: 155 exercises, each one animated: from a wall push-up to a free handstand, from a gentle neck stretch to burpees.
courses_sub: Every course has a host of its own who greets you on the home screen. Progress in a skill is shared between the courses that train it.
c_cali_desc: Bodyweight exercises from basic to advanced. Build strength, endurance, and body control.
c_healthy_desc: Exercises for desk workers. Fix posture, release neck tension, and improve flexibility — joint-friendly.
c_yoga_desc: Poses from easy to hard: standing poses, balancing on one leg, backbends, sun salutations and arm balances.
c_morning_desc: Wake your body up. Spine, joints, arms and a little energy: standing, quietly, no jumps.
c_evening_desc: A calm stretch before sleep. Back, hips, legs and shoulders: slowly, on the floor, ending lying down.
c_own_desc: Pick branches from any course or line up your own exercises — the app works out reps, sets and rests for you.
game_sub: Points, streaks, ranks and achievements turn a few minutes a day into a habit you don't want to break.
g1_p: Skill points for every set, with a bonus for the first workout of the day and for finishing everything.
g2_p: Train every day to keep the fire going. Every week of streak earns a freeze that saves it on a day you miss.
g3_p: From Beginner to Legend. A rank slowly fades if you stop, and comes back when you return.
g4_p: For your first pull-up and your first handstand, long streaks, finished branches — and one secret.
arena_p: Ready for the next stage? Skala the bull sets the norm and watches. Pass the challenge and the branch moves on.
f1_p: A cue for every moment — get ready, go, switch sides, rest is over — played over whatever you are listening to.
f2_p: Choose how much to do. Before you start, the app shows an honest estimate of today's plan.
f3_p: Your streak, rank and today's plan on the home screen, and on the iPhone lock screen too.
f4_p: Workouts can be saved to Apple Health or Google Health Connect.
f5_p: A morning reminder, an evening nudge and a warning when your streak is at risk — each one can be turned off.
f6_p: No install needed: open TreniDay in the browser and add it to your home screen.
priv_p: TreniDay has no server and no account. Everything you do is stored on your device and nowhere else. The code is open for anyone to read.
a1: Yes. TreniDay is free, with no ads, no subscriptions and no paid features.
a2: Almost nothing: a floor, a wall and sometimes a chair. A pull-up bar opens the Pull branch; without one the app plans your workouts around it.
a3: You choose the size: Short, Standard or Full. Before you start, the app estimates today's plan from the exercises in it and your own pace.
a4: Only on your device (in the web version, in your browser's storage). There is no account and nothing is sent to a server.
q5: Is there an app for iPhone and Android?
a5: The apps are coming to the App Store and Google Play. Until then the web version works on any phone and can be added to the home screen.
a5_testers: Google Play lets a new app in only after 12 people have tested it for two weeks. Have an Android phone and want the app sooner?
final_p: One short workout and today counts. Goro has warmed up already.
